readout_other: von Frey mechanical paw-withdrawal threshold; acetone and cold-water immersion withdrawal latency; menthol/capsaicin-evoked nocifensive response duration; Western blot for TRPM8/TRPV1 in DRG; immunohistochemistry for substance P in spinal dorsal horn
direction_notes: TUS reduced oxaliplatin-induced mechanical hyperalgesia and cold allodynia (increased paw withdrawal threshold/latency) and reduced oxaliplatin-related increases in TRPM8 protein in DRG and substance P in the spinal dorsal horn, versus sham-TUS.

exposures.label: Transcutaneous TUS to bilateral hindlimb (sural/peroneal nerve distribution)

target.label: bilateral hindlimbs innervated by sural and peroneal nerves

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed-mode TUS (1 MHz, ISATA = 0.5 W/cm2, 50% duty cycle) was applied for 5 min per session, one session per day for 10 consecutive days (days 13-22), by slowly moving the sound head in a small circular direction on the bilateral hindlimbs innervated by sural and peroneal nerves.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty-four animals were randomly divided into four groups: oxaliplatin and TUS treatment $( \mathbf { n _ { \alpha } } = \mathbf { \beta } 6 ,$ Oxa-TUS); oxaliplatin and sham TUS $( \mathbf { n _ { \alpha } } = \mathbf { \beta } _ { 6 }$ , OxasTUS); vehicle-only injection and TUS treatment (n 5 6, Veh-TUS); and vehicle-only injection and sham TUS (n 5 6, Veh-sTUS).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Twenty-four animals were randomly divided into four groups: oxaliplatin and TUS treatment $( \mathbf { n _ { \alpha } } = \mathbf { \beta } 6 ,$ Oxa-TUS); oxaliplatin and sham TUS $( \mathbf { n _ { \alpha } } = \mathbf { \beta } _ { 6 }$ , OxasTUS); vehicle-only injection and TUS treatment (n 5 6, Veh-TUS); and vehicle-only injection and sham TUS (n 5 6, Veh-sTUS). Each animal received a total of eight injections of either oxaliplatin or vehicle, administered at 3-d intervals (days 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19 and 22). TUS or sham-TUS intervention was started 4 h after the fifth oxaliplatin/vehicle administration and then continued for 10 consecutive d (one session per day, days 13–22). Sensory behavioral examinations were assessed on the day before the first administration of oxaliplatin/vehicle (day 0, Pre-oxa) and before (day 12, Pre-treat) and after (day 24, Post-treat) all TUS/sTUS treatments. Animals were sacrificed for immunoassays 4 h after completion of final assessments (day 24). Figure 1 is a schematic of the experimental design.

flags.reason: Study had 24 animals in 4 groups of 6; n_subjects here counts only the two groups receiving real TUS (Oxa-TUS, Veh-TUS = 12); the other 12 received sham TUS with device output set to zero.
Paper gives ISATA (0.5 W/cm2) as a device setting without stating whether it is a free-field/water-tank calibration or an in-tissue value, so placed in unspecified_domain.
PRF (250 Hz) computed as the reciprocal of the stated 2 ms on / 2 ms off cycle period; the paper does not itself use the term PRF.

Paper states the behavioural tester was blinded to the oxaliplatin-vs-vehicle drug condition; it does not explicitly say whether the tester (or TUS administrator) was blinded to TUS-vs-sham-TUS assignment.
Sural nerve has no dedicated vocabulary id; represented via the parent peripheral_nerve term alongside the more specific peroneal_nerve.
